source_method: Built-in image generation: two painted terrain candidates and two painted transparent flow candidates per variant; inspected flow selection, nearest-neighbor resize, palette indexing, depth haze, offset-and-blend wrap join

files.notes: Canopy sea and rivers; cliff waterfalls and rusted relay trellises. Deepest hazy ground plane; lowest contrast and green-teal atmospheric fade.

run_b.atlas_grid: 4x4 256x256 cells in 1024x1024 RGBA; JSON y measured from image bottom
run_b.point_origin: All emitter, pipe-end, and emergence points use (x,y) pixels from cell top-left.
run_b.brightness: Landmarks, pipes, fires, and sites opaque-pixel HSV value p90 <= 0.55; sparse fire cores and lamps may exceed it.
run_b.weather_alpha: Cloud banks <= 80, wisps <= 64, mist and pollen <= 48, smoke palls <= 56, spores <= 88 of 255.

run_c.atlas_grid: 1024x1024 RGBA, 4x4 grid of 256x256 cells; JSON y from bottom
run_c.lights_packing_exception: Five four-frame loops make 20 sprites. The final lights row packs strobe_white and fireflies into eight nonoverlapping 128x128 subcells; all other sprite rects are 256x256.
run_c.emitter_anchor: Ground-attached loops use local pixel (128,236) from top; strobe_white uses (64,121) in its half-size rect; fireflies are atmospheric.
